projects.title: ANF Inventory System
projects.subtitle: Adoración Nocturna Filipina National Council
projects.paragraph: I started it while working as the Council's assistant office manager, to automate the paperwork I was handling. It covers the Council's stock, Official Receipts, cash and check vouchers, petty cash, members, annual dues and officers, and runs on a single office PC. Officers can reach it from their phones over the office WiFi, and nothing goes to the cloud. Every peso and centavo is exact, and a checked backup is made within two minutes of any change. Built test-first, with every screen checked at eight widths from phone to desktop.

projects.title: EyeDTrack
projects.subtitle: Real-time driver attention monitoring, thesis
projects.paragraph: I led our thesis team. A Kotlin Android app streams in-car camera frames to a Python server, which detects drowsiness, yawning and distracted head movement in real time using CLAHE, Haar Cascade, eye and mouth aspect ratios, MobileNetV2 and LLaVA. Alerts go out by voice and push, with an event log for history.
projects.alt: Sheet 3 of 4, detail B, AI systems, with a live eye aspect ratio trace that raises an alert on a drowsy dip: EyeDTrack, real-time driver attention monitoring, thesis. 87.12% detection accuracy, 96.32% yawn precision, 0.95 seconds camera to alert. Team lead; Kotlin, Python, OpenCV; MobileNetV2 and LLaVA; February to June 2025.
